mt-01-rei-prometido.context: Matthew opens his Gospel by linking Jesus to the story of Israel. Before telling of the birth, he shows Joseph facing a pregnancy he cannot explain and God speaking to him in a dream.
mt-01-rei-prometido.focusQuestion: What changes for you in knowing that, in Jesus, God is with us?
mt-01-rei-prometido.keywordGloss: A name meaning God with us: God present with his people in the son who is born.
facts: Mary was found with child by the Holy Spirit before she and Joseph came together.
Joseph was righteous and decided to leave Mary quietly, without disgracing her.
An angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream.
The son will save his people from their sins.
Joseph obeyed the angel and took his wife home.

mt-02-reino-ensino.context: Jesus goes up a mountain and teaches the disciples before the crowds. His first words describe who is blessed in the Kingdom and the promise that goes with each one.
mt-02-reino-ensino.focusQuestion: Which of Jesus' promises do you most need to rest in today?
mt-02-reino-ensino.keywordGloss: The word that opens each sentence and links a trait of the disciple to a promise from God.
facts: Jesus went up a mountain and the disciples came to him.
The kingdom of heaven belongs to the poor in spirit.
Those who mourn will be comforted.
Those who hunger and thirst for righteousness will be filled.
Peacemakers will be called children of God.

mt-03-autoridade.context: After the teaching on the Kingdom, Matthew shows Jesus in action. On the Sea of Galilee, a storm threatens the boat while Jesus sleeps, and the disciples wake the Teacher in panic.
mt-03-autoridade.focusQuestion: In what storm of your life do you need to cry out to Jesus today?
mt-03-autoridade.keywordGloss: Jesus' power recognized when winds, sea and even demons obey him.
reflectionPrompts: Little faith and a cry for help
facts: The disciples followed Jesus when he got into the boat.
A great storm tossed the boat while Jesus slept.
The disciples woke Jesus, crying out for help.
Jesus rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a great calm.
The men marveled because winds and sea obey Jesus.
The demons call Jesus the Son of God.

mt-04-cruz-vitoria.context: After the resurrection, a false story about the tomb spreads, but the eleven disciples go to Galilee to meet Jesus, who sends them to all nations.
mt-04-cruz-vitoria.focusQuestion: To what person or place is Jesus sending you to bear witness?
mt-04-cruz-vitoria.keywordGloss: All authority in heaven and on earth, which Jesus declares he has received before sending the disciples.
facts: The eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had appointed.
When they saw Jesus, the disciples worshiped him, but some hesitated.
Jesus declares that all authority in heaven and on earth has been given to him.
The disciples are to make disciples of all nations.
Jesus promises to be with the disciples every day.

mt-boss-revisao.context: This challenge reviews the promised King in Matthew: his announced birth, his teaching on the Kingdom, his authority over the sea and his sending of the disciples to all nations.
mt-boss-revisao.focusQuestion: Which word of Jesus reviewed here do you need to keep this week?
mt-boss-revisao.keywordGloss: Jesus presented by Matthew as the promised King who saves, teaches, calms and sends.
reflectionPrompts: The King who saves from sins
facts: Mary's son will save his people from their sins.
The kingdom of heaven belongs to the poor in spirit.
Those who hunger and thirst for righteousness will be filled.
Jesus rebuked the winds and the sea, and there was a calm.
Winds and sea obey Jesus.
All authority in heaven and on earth was given to Jesus.
